(7) Subsections (3) to (5) of section 3 (method by which prosecutor discloses) apply for
the purposes of this section as they apply for the purposes of that.

(8) Material must not be disclosed under this section to the extent that the court, on an
application by the prosecutor, concludes it is not in the public interest to disclose it
and orders accordingly.

(9) Material must not be disclosed under this section to the extent that it is material the
disclosure of which is prohibited by [F27section 56 of the Investigatory Powers Act
2016] .]
